assumptions: absence of dependency is not commutation
near-optimal reduction is not assumed computationally attainable
stale/unknown witness falls back to raw
falsifier: No fully-costed sound residual over the strongest modern stateful POR/raw parent, any invalid behavior pruning/merge occurs, or the candidate relies on an infeasible near-optimal reduction objective.
hard_gate_obligations: fallback when reduction evidence is unknown
minimal_counterexamples: low-commutation workload where reduction analysis costs more than raw search
commutation valid in one state but invalid after a prefix
blocking creates stateful dependence invisible to a static independence relation
near-optimal reduction target is computationally intractable in the registered class
cache/reused witness is stale after transition or verifier revision
POR prunes behavior needed for final verified certificate
modern POR parent matches quotient savings at lower overhead
novelty_residual: Economically useful, context-sound stateful reduction beyond modern POR and the current Orion contextual quotient, without targeting globally near-optimal reduction.
object_description: Sound economically useful reduction of stateful interleavings using contextual equivalence/certification while benchmarking against modern stateful partial-order reduction and explicit raw search.
oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-world transition semantics enumerate true contextual independence and exact reachable behaviors. arXiv:2411.16921 supplies a complexity boundary: polynomially close-to-optimal stateful POR with blocking cannot be assumed generally unless P=NP; therefore the target is useful sound reduction, not universal near-optimality.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped stateful search-reduction efficiency only; no proof/scientific authority and no claim of universal near-optimal POR.
qoi: Paired fully-costed verified state/search reduction versus the strongest applicable stateful POR parent, with zero invalid merges and explicit reduction-quality/certification overhead.
same_system_ablation: Same transition systems under raw search, current contextual quotient, modern stateful POR, and the candidate's economic contextual reduction.

strongest_parents.justification: Current Orion contextual path-quotient parent with explicit state-indexed witnesses.
Modern stateful POR parent with practical algorithms and a load-bearing lower-bound result for near-optimal reduction with blocking.
No-reduction fallback is strongest when reduction/certification overhead dominates.
Small known worlds provide an upper bound on reducible interleavings and selector regret; not a promotable treatment.

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = reduction_analysis + witness_compute + witness_verify + reduced_search + quotient_bookkeeping + final_verification
